title: 空力解析演習
subtitle: Aerodynamics Analysis Exercises
teachers:
MORIAI Hideki
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
With the rapid development of computers, numerical simulations for aerodynamic analysis are essential in the aircraft design process.
In this practical training course, students will learn how to properly use numerical simulation for fluid dynamics in the aircraft design process. Students will also learn how to utilize numerical simulation to solve actual engineering problems that occur in their local community.
advice:
In this course, students will learn numerical analysis through the use of numerical analysis software.
We will cover the following materials:
1 Introduction to numerical simulation
2 Aerodynamic analysis
Geometry modelling, Meshing, Computational method, Initial and boundary conditions, Execution of analysis, Evaluation of results, Comparison with experimental results
books: Required materials will be specified in the first lesson.
requiredKnowledge:
It is recommended that students have already taken the following courses: Fundamentals of Fluid Mechanics, 3D-CAD, Aerodynamics for Aircraft I, and Mathematical Modeling and Programming.
The textbook will be handed out during the class.

activityGoals.body: Be able to conduct basic flow field by using standard numerical analysis software
Be able to explain factors that affect analysis results
Be able to obtain information from analysis results to understand the flow field

achievementLevels.ideal: In analysis of a 2D circular cylinder, set up a suitable boundary condition and recognize the influence of meshing on the computational result. In analysis of airfoil shapes, accurately compute the pressure distribution, lift, drag, and moment. In addition, evaluate the computational results based on knowledge of aerodynamics.
achievementLevels.standard: In analysis of a 2D circular cylinder, explain a suitable boundary condition and the influence of meshing on the computational result. In analysis of airfoil shapes, accurately compute the pressure distribution, lift, drag and moment.

              With the rapid development of computers, numerical simulations for aerodynamic analysis are essential in the aircraft design process.
In this practical training course, students will learn how to properly use numerical simulation for fluid dynamics in the aircraft design process. Students will also learn how to utilize numerical simulation to solve actual engineering problems that occur in their local community.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              In this course, students will learn numerical analysis through the use of numerical analysis software.
We will cover the following materials:
1 Introduction to numerical simulation
2 Aerodynamic analysis
Geometry modelling, Meshing, Computational method, Initial and boundary conditions, Execution of analysis, Evaluation of results, Comparison with experimental results

              教科書および参考書・リザーブドブック

              履修に必要な予備知識や技能

              It is recommended that students have already taken the following courses: Fundamentals of Fluid Mechanics, 3D-CAD, Aerodynamics for Aircraft I, and Mathematical Modeling and Programming.
The textbook will be handed out during the class.
